notes.title: Major rewrite: anniversary edition
notes.content:
The game has been rewritten from scratch in a new engine and renamed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8530737/de3b88c907cba2f5353db1f0ced2342ba43a4d99.png[/img]

Numerous fixes, tweaks and improvements:
[list]
[*] Removed a particularly silly RNG mistake
[*] Redesigned some boss fights
[*] Added various graphical effects
[*] Added a "memory fragment" section
[*] Various level design tweaks
[*] Renamed the project (+ new logo etc)
[*] changed enemy behavior in some cases
[*] …so many other fixes and changes
[/list]
